newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr steady vs yen in Tokyo on mark/yen buying.
newsitem.headline: Dlr steady vs yen in Tokyo on mark/yen buying.

text.p: *Dollar remained well-bid against yen in mid-morning Tokyo trade on mark/yen buying, but upside capped by exporter sell orders above 117.00 yen, dealers said.
*Stop-loss mark buying for yen seen around 68.65 yen.
*Dollar underpinned by solid buy orders below 116.50 yen.
*Market participants in Tokyo cautious ahead of Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita news conference at 0600 GMT.
*Remarks by Matsushita on Japanese interest rates could weigh on dollar/yen, dealers said.
*Players also closely watching Japanese government bonds.
*"JGBs have been stable this morning but if the benchmark futures fall sharply below 123.00, that might have some impact on the yen," said a city bank trader.
*Key June JGB futures fell 0.09 to 123.06 by midday.
*Dealers expect yen/dollar to continue to be dictated by European currencies' moves ahead of second round of French parliamentary elections on next Sunday.
*In New York, dollar rose on comments by French National Assembly Speaker Philippe Seguin suggesting looser fiscal criteria and larger pool of entrants in the first wave of EMU.
*Dollar moving narrowly in early Tokyo trading near New York session high of 116.78 yen.
*Talk in market that stop-loss buying by U.S. operators may emerge near 117 yen, a trust bank dealer said.
*He said dollar may test topside if traders begin buying dollars in attempt to hit these stops.
*But exporter offers and possible long-liquidation sales by securities houses may weigh on dollar, dealers said.
